top_signals.title: Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor ransomware demands $5 million
top_signals.summary: Maersk announced that a threat actor gained unauthorized access to a local legacy system inherited through an earlier acquisition and extracted data from it. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: StoneX sees 111% upside for Securitize shares as tokenization revenue rebounds
top_signals.summary: StoneX maintained its Buy rating on Securitize, citing tokenized equities, fund demand, and structured credit as growth drivers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
